verdict.rationale: Lago ships a first-party Dunning Agent that works through overdue invoices on its own: it reads each customer's payment history, chases, and hands the remaining cases to a person. Lago also generates invoices automatically according to each plan model. Both are fixed, domain-specific automations, not a general facility for users to define their own background automations. missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, documented triggers or recurring schedules for custom automations, evidence the Dunning Agent runs unattended in the background with configurable cadence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: An AR analyst for overdue invoices. It reads each customer's payment history before it chases, and hands the rest to a person.
The Dunning Agent reads the account first: twelve months of invoices and payments, the disputes, the provider status.
Lago automatically generates invoices for each customer according to the plan model.
